title: Fast Nearest Neighbour Search (Wraps ANN Library) Using L2 Metric
text: Finds k nearest neighbours every point given dataset O(N log N) time using Arya Mount’s ANN library (v1.1.3). support approximate well exact searches, fixed radius searches bd well kd trees. package implements nearest neighbors Euclidean (L2) metric. Manhattan (L1) metric, install RANN1 package. details underlying ANN library, see http://www.cs.umd.edu/~mount/ANN.

what: Wrapper for Arya and Mount's Approximate Nearest Neighbours (ANN) C++ library — RANN-package
title: Wrapper for Arya and Mount's Approximate Nearest Neighbours (ANN) C++ library — RANN-package
text: Finds k nearest neighbours every point given dataset O(N log N) time using Arya Mount's ANN library (v1.1.3). support approximate well exact searches, fixed radius searches 'bd' well 'kd' trees. distance computed using L2 (Euclidean) metric. Please see package 'RANN.L1' functionality using L1 (Manhattan, taxicab) metric.

title: Nearest Neighbour Search — nn2
text: Uses kd-tree find p number near neighbours point input/output dataset. advantage kd-tree runs O(M log M) time.

title: Nearest Neighbour Search — nn2
code: nn2(   data,   query = data,   k = min(10, nrow(data)),   treetype = c("kd", "bd"),   searchtype = c("standard", "priority", "radius"),   radius = 0,   eps = 0 )

title: Nearest Neighbour Search — nn2
text: data M x d data.frame matrix, M rows point (column) vector (d=1). query set N x d points queried data. d, number columns, must data. missing, defaults data. k maximum number nearest neighbours compute. default value set smaller number columnns data treetype Character vector specifying standard 'kd' tree 'bd' (box-decomposition, AMNSW98) tree may perform better larger point sets searchtype See details radius Radius search searchtype='radius' eps Error bound: default 0.0 implies exact nearest neighbour search

title: Nearest Neighbour Search — nn2
text: list length 2 elements:  nn.idx N x k integer matrix returning near  neighbour indices. nn.dists N x k matrix returning near  neighbour Euclidean distances.

title: Nearest Neighbour Search — nn2
text: RANN package utilizes Approximate Near Neighbor (ANN) C++ library, can give exact near neighbours (name suggests) approximate near neighbours within specified error bound.  information ANN library please visit http://www.cs.umd.edu/~mount/ANN/. Search types: priority visits cells increasing order distance query point, hence, converge rapidly true nearest neighbour, standard usually faster exact searches. radius searches neighbours within specified radius point.  neighbours nn.idx contain 0 nn.dists contain 1.340781e+154 point.
